name: Sailboat Retrospective
deliverable: Categorized operational anchors, wind, goals, and hidden rocks

steps.text: Draw the boat, island, wind, anchors, and reefs, and say what each one stands for here.
Give eight silent minutes: at least two winds, two anchors, and one reef per person.
Insist on complete sentences that name an artifact, handoff, or event, not a mood.
Post notes beside similar ones; stack yours under an existing card to show its weight.
Walk the wall together and name the two anchors this team can cut this cycle.

failure: Anchors arrive as vague complaints and the room spends the hour on org-wide forces it cannot move.
intervention: Ask which specific handoff broke and what was missing from it, then park company-level items on the perimeter and return to the boat.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: A common agile retrospective metaphor; no single documented originator.
